name: Multi-country school picker
acceptanceCriteria: The /college-interviews setup page shows 3 country tabs: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, each with a flag emoji
United States is selected by default
Clicking 'United Kingdom' filters the school grid to UK schools (Oxford, Cambridge, LSE)
Clicking 'Canada' filters the school grid to Canadian schools (Toronto, McGill, UBC)
antiPatterns: All 25 schools shown regardless of country tab
Tab row missing or appears below the grid instead of above

screenshots.expect: default US country view of school grid
